gaps.name: Create a new group or channel
gaps.whatItIs: Modern client has a full creation flow: pick contacts, name + photo, then for channels a public/private step with username check, then landing in the new chat. Basic groups can also be upgraded to supergroups when a limit is hit.
gaps.whyItMatters: There is no way at all to create a group or channel from our client. A user can only join what already exists. This is the single largest hole in this area.
gaps.whereItGoes: New TGCreateGroupViewController pushed from a '+' item on TGChatListViewController and from TGContactsViewController; reuse the existing member-picker style from TGGroupMembersViewController. twelve/Telegraph has TGCreateGroupController and TGGroupInfoSelectContactController, so the flow can be ported almost verbatim.

gaps.name: Public username / t.me link for a group or channel
gaps.whatItIs: ChannelVisibilityController lets an owner switch a chat between private (invite link only) and public, type a username, see live availability checking, and see the list of public chats already created when the limit is hit.
gaps.whyItMatters: Owners cannot make a chat public or change its @name from our client, so a chat created elsewhere can never be published or renamed here.
gaps.whereItGoes: New section in the admin rows of TGProfileViewController ('Chat Type: Private/Public'), pushing a small username editor. twelve/Telegraph has TGCheckUsernameAvailabilityActor and TGApplyUsernameActor.

gaps.name: Per-post statistics
gaps.whatItIs: MessageStatsController shows views/forwards/reactions overview for one channel post, an interaction graph, a reaction graph, and a paged list of public channels that reposted it.
gaps.whyItMatters: Channel admins currently get chat-level numbers only; they cannot tell which post performed and who reshared it, which is the main reason to open statistics at all.
gaps.whereItGoes: New controller in TGProfileViewController.m alongside TGProfileStatisticsController, opened by tapping a recent post row; also reachable from the message action sheet in TGChatViewController for own channel posts.

gaps.name: Recent posts list in channel statistics
gaps.whatItIs: The channel stats screen ends with a 'Recent posts' section: each post with its thumbnail/first line, view count, share count and reaction count.
gaps.whyItMatters: This is the entry point to per-post stats and the only per-post feedback an admin gets. Our stats screen drops the data entirely.
gaps.whereItGoes: Third mode of TGProfileStatisticsController in TGProfileViewController.m; the payload is already parsed by TGClient under 'recent_interactions' but is never read by the UI.
tdlib: getChatStatistics - already wrapped and called; 'recent_interactions' key already returned
getMessage - wrapped, needed for the post preview text

gaps.name: Full graph set in statistics
gaps.whatItIs: ChannelStatsController and GroupStatsController render every graph TDLib returns (growth, followers, mute, views by hour, view sources, language, message/action/day-hour graphs for groups) with zoom.
gaps.whyItMatters: TGProfileStatisticsController calls -loadFirstGraph and shows exactly one chart; the other eight to ten graphs are fetched, held in self.graphs and thrown away.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGProfileStatisticsController in TGProfileViewController.m - the drawing code already exists, it needs a graph selector (segmented control or one section per graph) and a loop instead of loadFirstGraph.
tdlib: getStatisticalGraph - wrapped, already used for one graph

gaps.name: Top admins and top inviters in supergroup statistics
gaps.whatItIs: Group statistics list not just top posters but top admins (deletions, bans, restrictions) and top inviters (members added), each with a context menu to promote, restrict or open the profile.
gaps.whyItMatters: Moderating a busy group means knowing who is doing the moderating and who is bringing people in. We render only 'Top posters'.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGProfileStatisticsController in TGProfileViewController.m - 'top_administrators' and 'top_inviters' are already in the dictionary TGClient returns and are simply ignored.
tdlib: getChatStatistics - already wrapped and called; both keys already returned

gaps.name: Group management toggles that are wrapped but never shown
gaps.whatItIs: Modern group settings expose: chat history visible to new members, hide member list, aggressive anti-spam, approve new members (join by request), join to send messages, and restrict saving content.
gaps.whyItMatters: Every one of these is an admin decision with real consequences (spam floods, member-list privacy, forward protection) and none of them can be changed from our client even though the calls are wrapped.
gaps.whereItGoes: Admin rows section of TGProfileViewController (next to the existing Permissions / Slow Mode rows) - plain switch rows.

gaps.name: Transfer chat ownership
gaps.whatItIs: OwnershipTransferController hands a channel or supergroup to another admin after a password and recent-login check, with the specific TDLib error states (2FA not set, password too fresh, session too fresh) surfaced as instructions.
gaps.whyItMatters: An owner who wants to hand over a chat has no path at all here; it is irreversible and account-critical, so it is the sort of thing users go looking for and expect to find.
gaps.whereItGoes: Action in the member action sheet of TGGroupMembersViewController when the target is already an admin, backed by a small password prompt. Modern reference: submodules/TelegramUI/Components/PeerManagement/OwnershipTransferController.

gaps.name: Group sticker set
gaps.whatItIs: GroupStickerPackSetupController lets an admin attach a sticker pack to a supergroup so members see it in the sticker panel without installing it, with short-name search and a preview.
gaps.whyItMatters: It is a visible identity feature of a group and the sticker panel silently misses the group pack today.
gaps.whereItGoes: Admin rows of TGProfileViewController pushing a search field over the existing sticker list UI in TGStickersViewController; the panel side is TGStickerPanelView.

gaps.name: Similar / recommended channels
gaps.whatItIs: Opening a channel profile shows a row of similar channels TDLib recommends, so a user can discover related channels from the one they just found.
gaps.whyItMatters: It is the only in-app channel discovery surface; without it, channels are only reachable via links and search.
gaps.whereItGoes: A section at the bottom of the channel branch of TGProfileViewController, rendered as a plain list of rows rather than the modern horizontal card strip.
tdlib: getChatSimilarChats - NOT wrapped anywhere in TGClient+*.h
